sloka: ततः सर्वाः प्रकृतयो हृष्टपुष्टजनावृताः ।गच्छन्तमन्वगछंस्तं राघवं गुणरञ्जिताः ।। ७.१०९.१४ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ sarvāḥ prakṛtayo hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāvṛtāḥ ।gacchantamanvagachaṁstaṁ rāghavaṁ guṇarañjitāḥ ।। 7.109.14 ॥

translations.english: Then, all the subjects, filled with joyful and well-nourished people, who were charmed by Rama's virtues, followed him as he departed.
